name: Jagananna Vidya Deevena (Reimbursement of Tuition Fee)
description: Full tuition fee reimbursement for eligible SC, ST, BC, EBC, Kapu, Minority, and Differently-Abled students pursuing higher education in Andhra Pradesh.
landHoldingMax: 10 acres wet OR 25 acres dry OR 25 acres combined
otherConditions: No family member should be a government employee/pensioner (sanitary workers exempted)
No family member should own a four-wheeler (taxis/tractors/autos exempted)
No family member should be an income tax payee
Urban property must be less than 1,500 sq ft built-up area
Must be admitted under convener quota (management/spot quota is ineligible)
benefits: Full fee reimbursement (tuition fee, special fees, other fees, and exam fees) credited directly to the college account.
applicationSteps: Download the Jnanabhumi Scholarship Application Form (J-SAF) from jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in or collect it from your college.
Fill in the J-SAF and submit the signed copy to your College Principal.
The College Principal verifies and submits the application online through Jnanabhumi at the time of admission.
You receive an SMS confirming successful submission.
Visit a Mee Seva Centre with your Jnanabhumi application ID and Aadhaar for biometric authentication.
deadlineNote: Application window typically opens in August and closes in October; confirm exact dates on the Jnanabhumi portal.

name: Jagananna Vasathi Deevena (Maintenance Fee)
description: Hostel and mess fee assistance for eligible students pursuing higher education in Andhra Pradesh, credited to the mother's bank account.
landHoldingMax: 10 acres wet OR 25 acres dry OR 25 acres combined
otherConditions: No family member should be a government employee/pensioner (sanitary workers exempted)
No family member should own a four-wheeler (taxis/tractors/autos exempted)
No family member should be an income tax payee
Must be admitted under convener quota
benefits: ₹10,000/year for ITI students, ₹15,000/year for Polytechnic students, and ₹20,000/year for Degree and above courses, credited directly to the mother's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
applicationSteps: Apply through the same Jnanabhumi scholarship application process as Jagananna Vidya Deevena.
Ensure your mother's Aadhaar-linked bank account details are correctly entered in the J-SAF form.
The College Principal submits your application online through Jnanabhumi.
Maintenance fee is disbursed to the mother's account after verification.
deadlineNote: Same window as Jagananna Vidya Deevena; confirm exact dates on Jnanabhumi.

name: Jagananna Amma Vodi
description: Financial assistance of ₹15,000 per year to mothers from BPL families who send their children to government or government-aided schools in Andhra Pradesh.
incomeRule: BPL family holding a white or pink ration card
otherConditions: Child must be enrolled in a government or government-aided school
Family must hold a white or pink (BPL) ration card
Child must be studying in Classes 1 to 12
benefits: ₹15,000 per year per enrolled child, credited directly to the mother's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
documents: Mother's Aadhaar card (for identity reference only)
White or pink ration card (BPL card)
Child's school enrollment proof (collected by the school)
applicationSteps: Ensure your child is enrolled in a government or government-aided school in Andhra Pradesh.
The school collects the mother's Aadhaar number, bank account details, and ration card type.
The school submits this data to the AP Education Department.
Revenue and Education departments cross-verify eligibility.
The beneficiary list is published on the school notice board.
₹15,000 is credited to the mother's account in January each year.
deadlineNote: Enrollment is through the school; annual payment is made in January. No individual application deadline as such — coordinate with your child's school.

name: AP Post-Matric Scholarship (SC/ST/BC/EBC/Minority)
description: Scholarship for students pursuing post-matriculation courses (Intermediate through PhD) in Andhra Pradesh, covering tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance.
landHoldingMax: 10 acres wet OR 25 acres dry OR 25 acres combined
otherConditions: No family member should be a government employee/pensioner
No family member should be an income tax payee
Must be admitted under convener quota
benefits: RTF (full tuition fee reimbursement to college) + MTF (maintenance fee of ₹10,000–₹20,000 per year to the student's account).
applicationSteps: Obtain the Jnanabhumi Scholarship Application Form (J-SAF) from your institution or download it from jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in.
Fill in the form and submit it to your institution's scholarship section.
The institution verifies and submits the application online through Jnanabhumi.
Fresh students complete biometric authentication at a Mee Seva Centre.
Renewal students complete biometric authentication at their college.
Scholarship is disbursed after verification and approval.
deadlineNote: Application window typically opens in August and closes in October; confirm exact dates on Jnanabhumi.

name: AP Pre-Matric Scholarship for Differently-Abled Students
description: Scholarship for differently-abled students studying in Classes 1 to 10 in Andhra Pradesh, with parental income below ₹1,00,000 per annum.
otherConditions: Student must be differently-abled
Studying in Classes 1 to 10
benefits: Scholarship amount as per government-prescribed rates for pre-matric differently-abled students.
applicationSteps: Obtain the application form from your school or the District Differently-Abled Welfare Office.
Fill in the form and attach all required documents.
Submit the application through your school to the concerned welfare department.
The department verifies eligibility and sanctions the scholarship.
Scholarship amount is credited to the student's bank account.
deadlineNote: Deadline not officially confirmed; contact your school or District Differently-Abled Welfare Office.

name: AP Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minority Students
description: Scholarship for economically backward minority students studying in Classes VI to X in Andhra Pradesh.
otherConditions: Student must belong to a minority community
Family income must not exceed ₹12,000 per annum
benefits: Scholarship amount as per government-prescribed rates for pre-matric minority students.
applicationSteps: Obtain the application form from your school or the AP State Minorities Finance Corporation (APSMFC) website (apsmfc.com).
Fill in the form and attach all required documents.
Submit the application through your educational institution only.
The institution forwards it to the concerned minorities welfare department.
Scholarship is sanctioned and disbursed after verification.
deadlineNote: Deadline not officially confirmed; check with your school or apsmfc.com.

name: NTR Vidyonnathi Scheme (Free UPSC Coaching)
description: Free coaching for UPSC Civil Services Examination for students from SC, ST, BC, Kapu, Brahmin, Minority, and EBC categories in Andhra Pradesh, with a stipend for books and lodging.
courseTypes: Any bachelor's degree (final-year students can apply)
otherConditions: Must hold a bachelor's degree from a recognised institution (final-year students can apply)
Must not be receiving other government scholarships
Previous beneficiaries of NTR Vidyonnathi cannot reapply
benefits: Coaching fee up to ₹1.5 lakh, stipend of ₹10,000 for books/stationery/lodging, and one-time travel allowance of ₹2,000.
documents: Bachelor's degree certificate or final-year bonafide
applicationSteps: Visit the Jnanabhumi portal (jnanabhumi.ap.gov.in).
Click on the 'NTR Vidyonnathi Application Form' link.
Fill in the online application form with your personal, educational, and category details.
Upload scanned copies of your study certificates, income certificate, and caste certificate.
Submit the application before the deadline.
Shortlisted candidates appear for a screening entrance exam.
Selected students are informed via SMS and choose their preferred coaching institute.
deadlineNote: Annual notification; check Jnanabhumi for the current year's deadline.

name: Bharati Scheme for Education (AP Brahmin Welfare Corporation)
description: Education scholarship for Brahmin students pursuing school, undergraduate, or postgraduate courses in Andhra Pradesh, with family income up to ₹3,00,000 per annum.
otherConditions: Student and both parents must belong to the Brahmin community
Parents must reside in Andhra Pradesh
Student must be enrolled in the Praja Sadhikara Survey (PSS)
Pursuing a regular course in a recognised institution
benefits: Financial assistance for education as per the scheme's course-wise rates.
documents: Income certificate (issued by Mee Seva/Revenue Authorities)
applicationSteps: Visit the Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation website (andhrabrahmin.ap.gov.in).
Navigate to the Bharati Scheme for Education section.
Register and fill in the online application form.
Upload the required documents (income certificate, caste certificate, etc.).
Submit the application and note the reference number.
Track the application status on the portal.
deadlineNote: Deadline not officially confirmed; check andhrabrahmin.ap.gov.in for the current notification.
